title: Part 3 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 3 Determination of Moisture Expansion Using Boiling Water ( Second Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 3) covers methods of test for determining the moisture expansion of both glazed and unglazed ceramic tiles.
clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 3 Determination of Moisture Expansion Using Boiling Water

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
